ov: Over 2,400 species of predatory insects with big, grasping front legs held folded as if praying. Their closest relatives are termites and cockroaches.

why.p: Mantises are among the insects most commonly kept as pets.

df: Mostly ambush predators of other insects.
fx: Mantises are sometimes mistaken for stick insects and grasshoppers.
notes: Group entry. ANSWER CHECK (fact): the animals.js fact "The only insect that can turn its head to look behind it" overstates it. The article says "some species of mantis can rotate their heads nearly 180°", not that it’s the only insect. Suggested wording: "Some can turn their heads nearly 180 degrees." RESOLVED (owner: approve all): fact rewritten as suggested.
